title: ICAR Develops India's First Complete Pigeonpea Genome ('Asha' Variety)
summary: Telomere-to-telomere reference genomes enable molecular breeding of climate-resilient pulse crops.

blocks.content: Telomere-to-telomere reference genomes enable molecular breeding of climate-resilient pulse crops.

items: ICAR developed India's first fully annotated telomere-to-telomere (**T2T**) reference genome for **pigeonpea (matar/arhar)**.
Variety Name: Pigeonpea variety **'Asha'** approved as global reference genome.
Milestone: First crop in India to have a fully annotated T2T reference genome (pigeonpea is India's 2nd most important pulse crop).
